description: Drives the "Club Legend" card tag. A player is a Club Legend only on cards for the club(s) listed here: inducted into that club's Hall of Fame, or a long-serving, trophy-winning great the club itself treats as an icon. Clubs use the game's current display names. born = birth year, used to avoid tagging a namesake.
sources: Leeds RL Hall of Fame: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leeds_Rhinos (2017-21), https://www.therhinos.co.uk/article/19049 (2023), https://www.therhinos.co.uk/article/20528 (2024), https://www.therhinos.co.uk/article/21723 (2025), https://therhinos.co.uk/article/23368 (2026)
